Welcome!

The King's Men (TKM) is a guild for everyone! We are a friendly guild that is fast to welcome others to join us! If interested in joining, contact me with a message on here, theTownstons, or with an ingame message if you catch me online at some point.

Guild News

10-11-08 - TKM is finally created as a in-game posse!

8-18-08 - New guild website created! *Click Here*

8-16-08 - TKM is created by JOXY!
